about: Hand-written test messages for the scoreboard. Written on 21 Nov 2026 before any of them were run. 'speak' means the assistant should offer help; 'quiet' means it should not interrupt. 'scam' means the message should be flagged; 'genuine' means it should be left alone. Messages marked 'seen' were also used while the app was being built, so the score on the unmarked ones is the fairer number.
